quote: psoriatic arthritis; rheumatoid arthritis, including juvenile rheumatoid arthritis

quote: relief of moderate to severe pain such as that due to: surgery, cancer, trauma (soft tissue and bone), biliary colic

note: Hypertension indicated.

note: RA indicated.

quote: acute treatment of migraine with or without aura in adults
note: Migraine without aura named.

quote: treatment of adults with symptomatic obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM)
